title: Rename a function across files
prompt: Rename fetch_user to get_user everywhere in this project (definition, every caller, the tests) and keep the tests passing (`python3 -m unittest`). Don't leave an alias behind.

checks.run: python3 -c 'import app.users as u; assert hasattr(u, "get_user")'

notes: A refactor across four files; graded by the tests (including hidden ones that import the new name) and by the old name being gone.
